jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Integration Delivery
jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to combine hands-on software engineering with end-to-end ownership to build APIs and integrations that support business-critical operations while contributing to a reusable integration platform. Welcome to Sandvik Group IT!

Some of the things you'll do here:

Build and own integrations from initial design through deployment and production support.
Work with modern engineering practices covering APIs, automation, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.
Turn delivery experience into reusable components, templates and technical improvements.

Your mission

In this role, you design, develop and maintain custom integrations and APIs for business areas and projects built natively on Azure Integration Services. Your work combines hands-on engineering with production responsibility, and you ensure that each delivery follows standardized patterns for security, logging, monitoring, resilience and error handling. You’re part of the PA Engineering Platforms Integration team and report to the Competence Manager.

Job responsibilities:

Design and develop production-ready APIs and integrations using synchronous, asynchronous and event-driven patterns with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure API Management.
Build integration logic, APIs and automation components in C# or Python, supported by Bash or PowerShell scripting.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code for repeatable, automated deployments.
Implement technical guardrails for authentication, authorization, secrets, certificates, networking, logging, monitoring and policy validation.
Own live integrations in production, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident resolution and performance improvements.
Convert delivery learnings into reusable templates, platform components, runbooks, post-mortems and clear technical documentation.

Location

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken.

Your profile

You’re an experienced integration engineer with a strong background in building and operating enterprise integrations. Combining software engineering with integration expertise, you understand how APIs, cloud services, automation and operations come together to create secure, reliable and maintainable solutions.

Your background also includes:

Hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure API Management. You’ve designed resilient integrations with effective retry, error-handling and monitoring approaches and understand the engineering practices required to operate integrations in production.
Strong programming skills in C# or Python, alongside experience using Bash or PowerShell for deployment and operational automation.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer Jönköping
jobs.description:
Sommaren börjar släppa taget och hösten närmar sig. Tempot skruvas upp igen, vardagen hittar tillbaka till sina rutiner – och kanske gör också tankarna på vad du vill framåt det.

Med några månader kvar av året kan det vara ett bra tillfälle att fundera över nästa steg. Kanske trivs du där du är, eller så börjar det kännas som att det är dags för något nytt. Ett nytt sammanhang, nya utmaningar eller helt enkelt en förändring inför nästa år.

Om de tankarna känns bekanta kanske det är hos Nexer som ditt nästa kapitel börjar.

Som konsult på Nexer får du arbeta med varierande uppdrag inom olika tekniker och branscher. Hos oss är varje uppdrag en chans att växa – vi tror stenhårt på utveckling. Vi tror också på en hållbar och långsiktig anställning, där kompetensutveckling och balans mellan arbete och fritid är självklara delar av vardagen.

Vem är du?

På Nexer i Jönköping fortsätter vi att bygga vårt team – nu söker vi erfarna Cloud & DevOps Engineers.

Vi söker dig som vill vara med och skapa moderna och hållbara molnlösningar för kunder inom olika branscher. Våra kunder finns inom bland annat industri, offentlig sektor och teknikintensiva verksamheter. Gemensamt för dem är att de står inför stora förändringsresor där molntjänster, automation, säkerhet och moderna utvecklingsplattformar är en viktig del av framtiden.

Som konsult hos oss blir du en del av ett team med hög kompetens och stort engagemang. Du arbetar i varierande uppdrag hos olika kunder där du får kombinera teknik, problemlösning och samarbete med både utvecklingsteam och verksamhet. Rollen passar dig som uppskattar att sätta dig in i nya miljöer, bygga relationer och skapa värde oavsett kundens tekniska plattform eller organisation.

Exempel på uppdrag

Bygga och vidareutveckla molnbaserade applikationer och plattformar
Modernisera befintliga system och migrera dem till molnet
Utforma lösningar med fokus på skalbarhet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet
Automatisera infrastruktur med Infrastructure as Code
Sätta upp CI/CD-flöden och automatiserade leveransprocesser
Arbeta med containers och Kubernetes-plattformar
Utveckla plattformar och arbetssätt som stärker utvecklingsteamens leveransförmåga
Arbeta med säkerhet, governance och kostnadsoptimering i molnmiljöer
Samarbeta med kunders utvecklings-, drift- och verksamhetsteam

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av

Minst en större molnplattform, exempelvis Azure, AWS eller GCP
Backend-utveckling i exempelvis .NET, Java, Node.js eller Python
Containers och orkestrering (Docker, Kubernetes)
Versionshantering och CI/CD-verktyg (Git, GitHub/GitLab, Azure DevOps eller Jenkins)
Infrastruktur som kod (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, ARM eller motsvarande)
Grundläggande säkerhetsprinciper i molnmiljöer, exempelvis IAM, secrets management och nätverk

Det är ett stort plus om du också har

Erfarenhet av serverless-lösningar, exempelvis Azure Functions eller AWS Lambda
Erfarenhet av observability och övervakning, exempelvis Datadog, Grafana eller Prometheus
Erfarenhet av Platform Engineering och utvecklarplattformar
Erfarenhet av större molnmigreringar eller transformationsprojekt
Certifieringar inom AWS, Azure, Kubernetes eller GCP

Vi söker dig som inte bara gillar teknik, utan också konsultrollen. Du tycker om att sätta dig in i nya verksamheter, bygga relationer och hjälpa olika kunder att hitta hållbara lösningar. Oavsett om du är specialist inom ett område eller har en bred teknisk profil tror vi att du drivs av att utvecklas tillsammans med både kunder och kollegor.

Rollen kräver att du obehindrat kan kommunicera på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Det är en viktig förutsättning för att lyckas i kunddialoger och i samarbetet med teamet.

Eftersom rollen innebär konsultuppdrag hos olika kunder ser vi också att du trivs med att arbeta i varierande miljöer. Resor förekommer i vissa uppdrag och därför är det en fördel om du är bekväm med ett visst mått av resande.

Tjänsten är placerad i Jönköping.

Vilka är vi på Nexer i Jönköping?

Hos Nexer i Jönköping får du arbeta i spännande och utvecklande uppdrag inom både offentlig och privat sektor. Vi samarbetar med verksamheter inom några av de mest teknikdrivna branscherna, exempelvis automotive, försvar och automatiserad industri.

Vi tror på kraften i mångfald och på att olika perspektiv skapar starkare team och bättre lösningar. Hos oss blir du en viktig del av det lokala teamet, där vi lägger stor vikt vid gemenskap, trygghet och tillhörighet. Vi vill skapa rätt förutsättningar för att du ska kunna utvecklas utifrån dina drivkrafter, ambitioner och mål.

Våra värderingar – Passion & Execution – genomsyrar vårt sätt att arbeta och samarbeta, både med kunder och med varandra.

Uppdragen genomförs antingen hos kund, i Nexers egna lokaler eller hemifrån – ofta i en flexibel hybridlösning. I vissa uppdrag arbetar du självständigt, i andra blir du en del av ett team tillsammans med flera kollegor från Nexer.

Ansökan

Du är varmt välkommen att söka tjänsten genom att skicka in din ansökan här nedan. Enligt GDPR hanterar vi inte ansökningar via e-post, men har du frågor om tjänsten eller Nexer är du välkommen att höra av dig till ansvarig rekryterare, Petra Sivefäldt, på petra.sivefaldt@nexergroup.com.

Vi tar emot ansökningar löpande så vänta inte med att söka!

jobs.title: Principal Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

The Role

This is a 0→1 build. You'll own the architecture, build and rollout of Neko's internal AI developer platform, shaping how our engineers design, ship and operate software through agentic, AI-assisted workflows.

It's a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll be the person setting long-term direction for AI agents, tooling and the systems underneath them, while also doing the work. The expectation is that what you build gets used across teams and meaningfully changes how engineering happens here.

What You'll Deliver

In the first 6 months

A clear architectural direction for the platform
Initial components shipped and adopted by early teams
Measurable improvements to developer speed, reliability and autonomy
Genuine organic adoption across engineering, driven by value not mandate

By month 12

A substantive shift toward agentic, engineer-led development workflows
Platform scaled beyond pilot groups to multiple teams
Clear ownership models for agents, tooling and supporting systems
Long-term architecture defined and moving toward maturity

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

Proven experience building and shipping an internal developer platform, hands-on, not advisory
A strong track record leading agentic or AI-assisted development work that engineers actually use day-to-day
Real backend engineering depth with production systems, recent Java or C# strongly preferred
Experience rolling out platform tooling to 20-30+ developers with meaningful adoption
Expertise with workflow engines such as AWS Step Functions, Azure Durable Functions, Temporal, Conductor or Dagster
The ability to drive change through influence and credibility, not positional authority
10-15+ years of engineering experience with substantial platform ownership

Nice to have

Full-stack exposure, though backend depth is the priority
Background in product-led SaaS or organisations with strong internal developer tooling culture

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med lösningsarkitektur i komplexa kundmiljöer där modern infrastruktur, automation, cloud och säkerhet möts? Vi söker en senior lösningsarkitekt som vill hjälpa våra kunder att designa hållbara, skalbara och tekniskt genomförbara lösningar, från behov och kravbild till arkitektur, implementation och vidareutveckling.

Din roll

Du blir en del av vårt team på Accelerate och arbetar i uppdrag hos marknadsledande kunder med digitalisering, modernisering och tekniska förändringsresor. Du arbetar nära verksamhet, utveckling, drift och säkerhet för att skapa lösningar som fungerar i praktiken, inte bara i teorin. I rollen bidrar du med arkitekturell höjd, teknisk förståelse och förmåga att hålla ihop helheten i komplexa miljöer. Du trivs i gränslandet mellan strategi och implementation och kan omsätta verksamhetsbehov, tekniska förutsättningar och krav till tydliga lösningsförslag, målarkitektur och genomförbara vägval.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

Ta fram lösningsarkitektur för moderna plattformar, integrationslandskap och cloud- eller hybridmiljöer
Driva tekniska vägval och arkitekturella beslut tillsammans med verksamhet, utveckling, drift och säkerhet
Designa hållbara, skalbara och förvaltningsbara lösningar inom integration, automation och plattformsteknik
Leda workshops, kravdialoger och tekniska forum i komplexa kundmiljöer
Dokumentera målarkitektur, integrationsflöden, beroenden och tekniska vägval
Bidra i moderniseringar, migreringar och större transformationsinitiativ
Säkerställa att lösningar fungerar långsiktigt utifrån krav på säkerhet, driftbarhet och förändringstakt
Fungera som teknisk brygga mellan strategi, arkitektur, utveckling, drift och leverans

Din profil

Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur, teknisk arkitektur eller en senior teknisk roll där du haft ansvar för design, vägval och helhetsperspektiv. Du är van att arbeta i komplexa enterprise-miljöer och har förmåga att förstå både tekniska detaljer och övergripande verksamhetsmål.

Du behöver inte kunna allt, men du behöver ha en stark teknisk grund, god kommunikativ förmåga och erfarenhet av att driva lösningsarbete tillsammans med kund och team. Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

För denna position kan svenskt medborgarskap krävas beroende på uppdrag. Vi utför även bakgrundskontroll av slutkandidat.

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:

Lösningsarkitektur i komplexa IT- eller enterprise-miljöer
Cloud, hybridmiljöer och moderna plattformar
Integrationer, API:er och systemlandskap
Infrastruktur, plattformsteknik eller utvecklingsnära miljöer
Säkerhetsmedveten arkitektur, exempelvis IAM, nätverk eller compliance
Workshopledning, kravdialog och stakeholder management
Agila arbetssätt och samarbete mellan verksamhet, utveckling och drift

Extra intressant om du har erfarenhet av:

Azure, AWS, Kubernetes eller OpenShift
DevOps, CI/CD, GitOps eller Infrastructure as Code
ServiceNow, Dynamics 365, SAP eller andra större verksamhetsplattformar
ITIL, ITSM eller arkitekturramverk
Informationssäkerhet, governance eller regulatoriska krav
Konsultrollen, rådgivning eller presale

Vi erbjuder dig

Som anställd på Accelerate erbjuder vi, förutom spännande uppdrag och tekniker:
Utbildning och certifieringar via våra partners (exempelvis Red Hat, HashiCorp, Microsoft, GitLab)
En trygg och säker anställning med bra förmåner
Kollektivavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och sjukvårdsförsäkring
Flexibilitet, frihet och balans mellan jobb och fritid
Att bli en del av ett passionerat team med tekniskt vassa kollegor
Möjlighet att arbeta nära kunder i uppdrag där arkitektur, teknik och affärsnytta möts

Vi tror på gemenskap och kompetensutbyte – här utvecklas vi tillsammans och stöttar varandra för att alltid ligga i framkant.

Accelerate finns på flertal orter i Sverige och Norge. För denna tjänst utgår du från vårt kontor i Malmö, med möjlighet till hybridarbete.

jobs.description:
About Keyfactor 

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!
Title
: Senior Cloud Engineer
Location
: Stockholm, Sweden
Experience
: Senior
Job Function
: Cloud Operations 
Employment Type
: Full-Time
Industry
: Computer and Network Security 
About the position

The Senior Cloud Engineer designs, implements, and evolves complex cloud infrastructure and automation solutions with a high degree of autonomy. This role owns systems and solutions that have significant impact on service reliability, security posture, and operational scalability. Senior Cloud Engineers act as technical leaders within the team, contributing to standards, mentoring peers, and supporting cross-functional initiatives.
The position can based in our Stockholm, we follow a hybrid work model with excellent flexible working practices. Applicants must hold a valid Right to Work in Sweden.

Responsibilities  

Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Owns and evolves complex Infrastructure as Code solutions across the cloud environment
Makes independent design decisions within established architectural standards
Delivers improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, and team efficiency
Provides technical guidance and review for less senior engineers

Configuration

Designs and maintains complex configuration management solutions
Defines configuration patterns and best practices used across the environment
Reviews and guides configuration work performed by other engineers

Data Center Operations

Maintains an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all physical hardware within the data center, such as HSMs, USBs, Smartcards, SSDs and Shock-Proof cases. Informs supervisor when certain materials are running low.
Maintains detailed records of all data center operation activities, including changes to tamper evident bag numbers, incidents, and access to client materials. Follows proper procedures on strict guidelines for Root Signings, Disaster Recovery, CRLs and CSR signings. Ensures proper asset disposal procedures are followed.
Is able to follow documented procedures on how to properly handle sophisticated hardware security modules and KVM devices. Can perform configurations of the hardware security module and KVM with supervision from more senior peers.

Task Automation

Designs and builds advanced automation solutions using scripting, APIs, and Azure-native services
Drives automation initiatives that improve operational consistency and efficiency
Supports process improvement through tooling and automation

Networking

Designs and implements cloud networking solutions within approved security and compliance constraints
Applies deep knowledge of networking protocols and standards to support hosted services
Participates in compliance audits and provides technical input

Monitoring & Alerting

Defines and improves monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies
Ensures monitoring logic supports service reliability and rapid incident detection
Mentors peers on monitoring best practices

Patch Management

Leads patch management strategies and execution
Resolves escalated patching issues and drives process improvements
Contributes to the evolution of patching standards and practices

PKI Knowledge

Applies strong understanding of PKI concepts in support of customer and hosted environments
Performs PKI tasks for custom deployments
Contributes to strategy and design discussions for hosted PKI services
Produces technical documentation for PKI designs and processes
Participates in cross-functional certificate reviews

Product Knowledge

Serves as a subject matter expert on Keyfactor’s hosted products
Troubleshoots complex product issues across hosted environments
Participates in strategy and design discussions for new product offerings
Supports testing of new product versions and provides feedback to product teams
Interfaces with customers on hosted architecture and security posture when required

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills  

High School Diploma or equivalent experience  
5+ years of related work experience and strong knowledge within their functional area
Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including native services and tooling
Deep hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools
Advanced proficiency in PowerShell scripting (high complexity)
Extensive experience with Windows systems administration, including Windows Roles & Features
and Active Directory
Advanced problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues
Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional demeanor
Strong organizational, time-management, and attention-to-detail skills
Proven ability to collaborate effectively within and across cross-functional teams
Self-motivated, able to manage complex work and projects to completion with minimal oversight
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Travel Requirements

Up to 15% travel time required

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience.  
Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits 

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas.  
Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:   
Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
Competitive time off globally.
Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees. 
DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology. 
The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts. 
Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays. 
Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development. 
Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings. 

Our Core Values 

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  
Trust
is paramount.

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.   
Customers
are core.

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.   
Innovation
never stops, it only accelerates.

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.   
We deliver with
agility
. 

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.    
United by
respect
. 

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.   
Teams
make “it” happen.

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Contract: 6-month internship

Start Date: Late January 2027

Work Model: Hybrid (3 days minimum onsite)

The Challenge Ahead

Frostbite is EA’s proprietary game engine, powering many of our leading titles across EA SPORTS, Battlefield, and more. We develop shared tools and technologies that connect and empower creators throughout EA. On Frostbite, you’ll collaborate with accomplished teams and contribute to the foundation that enables the creation of immersive, high-quality games for players worldwide.

As a Master's Thesis Intern, you will develop a project in an area where Frostbite's engineering efficiency can be multiplied with generative AI, agents, or context engineering. You will also gain an understanding of what it's like to work at EA. An open application means that you can provide ideas for what you want to work on, but we can also explore this together, based on your experiences and interests.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Integration Platform
jobs.description:
Do you want to shape how development teams across Sandvik build and operate integrations at scale? Join us in creating the platform capabilities, automation and templates that enable secure self-service delivery across the organization.

Some of the things you'll do:

Build reusable capabilities that reduce manual work and enable independence.
Influence the developer experience across APIs, integrations and event-driven solutions.
Collaborate closely with architects, product specialists, and development teams.

Your mission

In this position, you focus on building the tools, templates, and automation that enable development teams to create and operate integrations independently. Experience with end-to-end integration delivery is great to have, although this work centers on reusable platform capabilities rather than individual integrations. Working from vendor-agnostic principles, you turn standards and architectural direction into practical platform capabilities that perform reliably in production. You’re part of the PA Engineering Platforms Integration team and report to the Competence Manager.

Job responsibilities:

Build and maintain our self-service integration builder using reusable platform components, templates and shared services for APIs, integrations and event-driven solutions built on top of Azure Integration Services.
Develop CI/CD pipelines, automation services and utilities that support platform delivery and operations.
Embed security, logging, reliability, quality and compliance controls into pipelines and templates.
Translate architecture and technical standards into consistent, production-ready implementation patterns.
Onboard and support development teams using the platform, improving its capabilities based on their feedback.
Troubleshoot live integrations and take ownership of platform components in production.

Location

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken.

Your profile

You’re an experienced engineer with a strong software development foundation and exposure to platform engineering, DevOps and enterprise integration environments. Translating architectural direction and technical standards into reusable solutions comes naturally to you, and you enjoy creating capabilities that other development teams can adopt with confidence.

Your background also includes:

Hands-on production experience with Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management (APIM), and Service Bus or Event Grid.
Strong programming skills in C# or Python, combined with the ability to write and troubleshoot Bash and/or PowerShell scripts.
Experience with integration patterns, including APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture, and API gateways or enterprise integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD, deployment automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep or similar), and cloud-native environments.
Experience working with distributed systems and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Additionally, experience with front-end technologies such as React or Angular, as well as relational and NoSQL databases, is considered an advantage.

With a developer-first mindset, you balance high technical standards with pragmatic decisions that move work forward. You communicate complex topics clearly, collaborate constructively, and take ownership of what you build, while continuously improving the experience for teams using the platform.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.

As a part of this role, as a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a part of the Identity for Services (ID4S) Team, part of Microsoft Entra. The mission of this team is to make it hard to get authentication and authorization wrong. We believe the tasks to get authentication and authorization right, actively preventing security incidents, and always being updated for a service should be straightforward and at the same time provide operational insights as part of the platform. As a team, we take meaningful steps daily to achieve our mission supporting developers, security operations, and administrators. Our solution is used across thousands of internal Microsoft services, and several of our components are available as open source on GitHub. Our main authentication SDK is written in .NET, and we focus on building robust, extensible APIs that minimize resource usage while maximizing security and resilience. We also embrace AI-powered workflows to accelerate development and improve efficiency. Our team is enthusiastic about exploring new ways to co-create with AI and leverage it for better engineering outcomes. There are still many challenges for us to solve to deliver on our mission, and to help us we are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer who thrives on building seamlessly integrated components running in high-scale services where security, resilience, memory, and performance are daily motivators. You work effectively across a large set of organizations and teams company-wide and operate with a customer-first mindset. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

experience with Distributed Services

experience with SDK and/or experience high scale services

Experience with .NET

jobs.title: Snr GMP Software Developer
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for someone with a strong software engineering background who understands the full development lifecycle — from design and coding through testing, release, and operations — and who can translate that understanding into a DevOps strategy and CI/CD approach that integrates smoothly with how our development teams actually build software.
We are looking for a talented and driven DevOps Lead to define and own our DevOps strategy — the engineering practices, toolchain, and delivery infrastructure that determine how software is built, tested, and released across the organisation. A key initial focus for this role is our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) programme, where you will bridge development, operations, and quality in a regulated manufacturing environment, but the role's remit extends beyond any single platform. Prior exposure to MES platforms such as Syncade is a plus, but not a prerequisite.
Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that reflect a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring builds, tests, and deployments integrate smoothly with how engineering teams design, code, and release software — including for MES deployments across development, test, and production environments
Develop, own, and continuously evolve our DevOps strategy — defining the target toolchain, automation approach, and ways of working that align development and operations across the organisation, with the MES programme as an initial priority area.
Work with MES Vendors to define requirements and shape development to align to the DevOps strategy
.
Own the DevOps toolchain — source control, build automation, release management, environment provisioning, monitoring, and observability.
Define and enforce branching strategies, code review processes, and release management standards appropriate to a regulated manufacturing environment.
Work closely with vendors, system integrators, and internal teams to understand platform architecture and translate this into maintainable infrastructure-as-code and deployment automation.
Lead environment management across the software estate — including MES ensuring environments are correctly configured, version-controlled, and fit for purpose across all lifecycle stages.
Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to provide operational visibility of MES platform health and performance.
Drive shift-left quality practices — working with the testing team to embed automated testing into pipelines and ensuring quality gates are robust.
Support computer system validation (CSV) activities, maintaining audit trails, deployment records, and change control documentation in compliance with GxP requirements.
Manage infrastructure provisioning supporting workloads, ensuring security, resilience, and scalability.
Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the delivery pipeline, continuously improving deployment frequency, lead time, and recovery metrics (DORA).
Act as a technical authority and escalation point for infrastructure and deployment issues across the MES programme.

Essential Requirements

Software development background — hands-on experience as a software engineer or developer, with a solid grasp of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), coding practices, and application architecture, and the ability to use that experience to shape how DevOps and CI/CD integrate with development teams' ways of working.
Proven experience in a DevOps Lead or Senior DevOps Engineer role on complex enterprise software programmes.
Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling — Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent.
Solid understanding of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) and configuration management practices.
Experience managing environments for large-scale enterprise applications, including environment promotion strategies and configuration management.
Proficiency in scripting languages (PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar) for automation and tooling.
Demonstrated experience defining or evolving a DevOps strategy or roadmap — toolchain selection, automation approach, and ways of working — grounded in a strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, release management, and change control in enterprise settings.
Experience working in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, life sciences, or similar) with awareness of compliance and validation requirements.
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure and deployment issues under pressure.

Desirable Requirements

Direct experience deploying, maintaining, or supporting off-the-shelf MES platforms— including configuration, and upgrade activities.
Familiarity with GxP computer system validation (CSV), GAMP 5 lifecycle, and associated documentation requirements (IQ, OQ, PQ).
Knowledge of containerisation technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and their applicability within regulated manufacturing environments.
Understanding of MES integration patterns — ERP (SAP), LIMS, historian, and shop-floor device connectivity.
Experience with security hardening, vulnerability management, and operational security in manufacturing environments.

What you need

We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.

Systems administration
Distributed systems
Network Administration
Database architecture and administration
Application Architecture
Data architecture and design
Performance tuning and benchmarking

It’s crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Genuine desire to help people
Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.description:
Vi ser etter en kreativ og nysgjerrig seniorutvikler
som vil utvikle systemintegrasjoner og automatisering for KSAT. Sammen med teamet bygger du løsninger som oppdager feil, setter hendelser i sammenheng og automatiserer feilretting.

Du vil jobbe i et tverrfaglig team tett på operasjonsmiljøene våre. Arbeidet omfatter blant annet drivere, scrapere, monitorering og integrasjoner mellom tekniske systemer og hendelseshåndtering. Vi skal gjøre komplekse driftsdata om til nyttig informasjon og konkrete handlinger.

Som seniorutvikler får du bidra til tekniske veivalg og utvikle skalerbare, standardiserte og gjenbrukbare løsninger. Vi ønsker også at du deler kunnskap og bidrar til å gjøre teamet bedre. Arbeidssted kan være enten Oslo eller Tromsø.

Dette vil du jobbe med

Bryte ned komplekse behov til konkrete, gjennomførbare utviklingsoppgaver.
Utvikle integrasjoner for innsamling, bearbeiding og tilgjengeliggjøring av data.
Utvikle regler og algoritmer som oppdager avvik, korrelerer hendelser og støtter identifisering av rotårsaker.
Samle og berike alarmer før de sendes videre til systemet for hendelseshåndtering.
Utvikle automatisert feilretting med tydelige kontrollmekanismer.
Bidra til arkitektur, kodekvalitet og felles utviklingspraksis.

Vi ser etter deg som har

Solid erfaring med systemutvikling og kompetanse innen relevante teknologier, som Rust, C# eller React.
Erfaring med Docker, Kubernetes og skymiljøer, samt god forståelse av nettverk.
Erfaring med databaser, datasett og behandling av data fra ulike kilder.
Kunnskap om dataanalyse og erfaring med å finne mønstre og korrelasjoner i logger, måledata eller hendelser. Du forstår forskjellen mellom korrelasjon og årsakssammenheng.
Erfaring med agentisk utvikling, der KI-agenter brukes til å planlegge, implementere, teste og forbedre kode, med kritisk vurdering og kvalitetssikring av resultatene.
Evne til å skrive god, lesbar og vedlikeholdbar kode som i stor grad dokumenterer seg selv, og dokumentere arkitektur og viktige tekniske beslutninger.
Gode problemløsningsferdigheter og evne til å forstå både detaljene og systemet som helhet.
Evne til å samarbeide tett med utviklere, operasjonsteam og andre fagmiljøer for å løse reelle brukerbehov.

Kjennskap til tjenesteleveranse og hendelseshåndtering etter ITIL-rammeverket er en fordel.

Du trenger ikke kunne alt

Kjenner du deg igjen i omtrent 70 prosent av det vi beskriver? Da oppfordrer vi deg til å søke. Vi verdsetter solid utviklerkompetanse, nysgjerrighet og vilje til å lære, og forventer ikke at du har erfaring med alle teknologiene vi bruker.

KSAT - A Stellar Workplace

Vi er en organisasjon i stor vekst og med solid økonomi. I KSAT møter du et aktivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og vi ønsker noen som vil bygge videre på dette. Hos oss får du dyktige og engasjerte kolleger, en fleksibel og variert hverdag, fantastiske utviklingsmuligheter og en unik mulighet til å være med på å utvikle en spennende fremtid for KSAT.

Om ikke dette var nok, så tilbyr vi også blant annet:

Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser, kursing, treningsrom på arbeidsplassen, svært gode helseforsikringer og pensjonsordninger, telefon og mobilabonnement, firmahytte, støtte til idrett m.m.
Vi er en sosial gjeng som gjør ting utenfor jobb, både i regi av bedriften og på privat initiativ. Her blir du inkludert fra dag én.
Et miljø du garantert vil lære av - uansett kompetansenivå i dag. Du kommer til et miljø med høy kompetanse og med et sterkt ønske og vilje til å levere kvalitet i verdensklasse - i alle ledd i organisasjonen

Du kan bli bedre kjent med oss gjennom SPACE UP YOUR CAREER https://karriere.ksat.no/ . Her vil du se hvordan vi jobber samt få muligheten til å bli kjent med mange av de fine folkene i KSAT.

KSAT legger vekt på å sikre mangfold i bedriften ved å ta hensyn til kjønn, alder og kulturell bakgrunn under rekrutteringen.

Stillingen kan kreve at man oppfyller vilkår for norsk sikkerhetsklarering, samt kunne autoriseres og være skikket til stillingen. Sluttkandidater vil måtte gjennomføre en bakgrunnssjekk av Semac.

jobs.title: Solution Architect | AI & Dynamics 365
jobs.description:
Vær med å forme fremtidens Dynamics 365-løsninger med AI

I Cepheo hjelper vi virksomheter med å lykkes med digital transformasjon gjennom forretningsløsninger, data-, sky- og AI-løsninger basert på Microsoft Dynamics 365 plattformen. Med kunder på tvers av bransjer og sterke fagmiljøer i hele Norden jobber vi tett med kundene våre, fra strategi og implementering til videreutvikling og verdiskaping.

AI er i ferd med å endre måten virksomheter bruker forretningssystemer på. Som Microsoft-partner ønsker vi å ligge i front av denne utviklingen, og vi investerer betydelig i kompetanse innen områder som Copilot, AI-agenter, automatisering og intelligente forretningsprosesser.

Nå søker vi en Solution Architect - AI & Dynamcis 365 som ønsker å kombinere erfaring fra Dynamics 365 med en spesialisering innen kunstig intelligens. Rollen passer for deg som har noen års erfaring med Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations / Business Central) eller tilsvarende løsninger, og som ønsker å ta neste steg mot en arkitektrolle med AI som faglig spisskompetanse.

Om rollen

Som Solution Architect - AI & Dynamics 365 vil du jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom Dynamics 365, Microsoft AI-teknologi og kundenes forretningsprosesser.

Du vil bidra til å designe fremtidige løsninger hvor AI, Copilot og automatisering er en naturlig del av brukeropplevelsen og arbeidsprosessene. Samtidig vil du få muligheten til å bygge dyp kompetanse innen Microsofts AI-teknologier gjennom kundeprosjekter, interne prosjekter, fagmiljøer og samarbeid med våre AI-spesialister i Norden.

Dette er en rolle for deg som er teknologisk nysgjerrig, liker å forstå hvordan systemer henger sammen, og som ønsker å vokse inn i en sentral arkitektrolle.

Du vil blant annet jobbe med

Designe og videreutvikle løsninger basert på Dynamics 365 og Microsoft-plattformen
Identifisere hvordan AI kan skape verdi i ERP- og forretningsprosesser, både internt i Cepheo og ut mot kunder
Utforske og implementere løsninger basert på Copilot, AI-agenter og automatisering
Løsningsarkitektur i kundeprosjekter
Analysere kundebehov og omsette disse til fremtidsrettede løsninger
Være bindeledd mellom forretning, prosesser og teknologi
Workshops og kundedialog knyttet til AI og Dynamics 365
Bygge kompetanse innen Microsoft AI, Power Platform, Copilot og Azure AI Services
Bidra til å utvikle Cepheos AI-satsning og metodikk

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du har erfaring fra en eller flere av følgende roller:

Minst 3 års erfaring med Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Business Central eller tilsvarende ERP-løsninger, fra partner- eller kundesiden
God forståelse for forretningsprosesser, for eksempel innen økonomi, logistikk, innkjøp eller produksjon
Erfaring med å snakke med både forretningsfolk og teknikere, og å få dem til å forstå hverandre
Et genuint engasjement for AI og for hvordan det kan forbedre både kundens og våre egne prosesser
God muntlig og skriftlig kommunikasjon på norsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk, og på engelsk
Erfaring med løsningsdesign eller arkitektur
Prøvd Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure OpenAI eller lignende, i jobb eller på eget initiativ
Relevante sertifiseringer, for eksempel PL-600, MB-700 eller AI-102

Det viktigste for oss

Du trenger ikke være AI-ekspert i dag.

Det viktigste er at du har en solid bakgrunn innen Dynamics 365 eller tilsvarende løsninger, er nysgjerrig på hvordan AI vil endre måten virksomheter jobber på, og har lyst til å utvikle deg til å bli en av Cepheos fremtidige løsningsarkitekter innen AI og løsningsarkitektur.

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Our purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How You'll Make An Impact

The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

What You'll Do

Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.
Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.
Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.
Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.
Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.
Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.
Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

Success looks like

First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.
First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.
Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.
Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.
Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.
Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

What You'll Bring With You

Critical competencies

Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.
Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.
Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.
Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.
Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.
Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

Experience We Would Like To See

We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET
Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React
Comfortable with SQL and relational data
Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review
Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs
Some exposure to automated testing
Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not
Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

How We Use AI In This Hiring Process

We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.
What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

At Planday, we offer you

Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation
On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan
Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us
Flexible remote work
Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities
Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe
Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values—empathy, accountability, clarity, and growth—guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

About The Role

We are looking for a techno-functional consultant who operates at the intersection of product depth and business outcome: someone who has been hands-on with enterprise platforms, understands what they are looking at in a customer's environment, and applies that fluency to drive adoption and value realization with SitecoreAI.

You will own the post-sale adoption relationship for the customers on our premier success package (Sitecore360) in your portfolio, partnering with the Account Executive who owns the commercial relationship and leading the customer from onboarding through adoption, value realization and renewal readiness. You will tailor each engagement, identify where deeper technical delivery is needed and connect the product to the business outcomes the customer signed up for. Success is measured by customer adoption and realized business value, not hours delivered.

You will be part of our Customer Value Realization (CVR) team and work alongside Account Executives, Solution Engineers, Technical Consultants, Product Support and Product Engineering/Management internally, and alongside the customer's implementation partner externally.

What you’ll do[DH1] [CFG2] [KM3]

Own the post-sales product success relationship for Sitecore360 customers across onboarding, adoption and strategic advisory[DH4] [KM5] on use of Sitecore products.
Run structured, instance-led discovery: review the customer’s actual implementation, identify where setup decisions are blocking adoption and bring a point of view on what to change.
Deliver mid-level technical and advisory work directly. Scope deeper delivery for our technical Consultants so they can execute without a follow-up call[DH6] [KM7] and incorporate the output into the success plan.
Build, agree and maintain a 90-day success plan per customer with testable success criteria tied to business outcomes, tracked in our Customer Success platform.
Coordinate delivery activities across internal resources and technical Consultants, ensuring scoped work is sequenced against the plan.
Enable authors and operators to adopt SitecoreAI agentic workflows in their real business context.
Align partner- and IT-led implementations to a success plan. Validate that delivery milestones map to business outcomes. Escalate misalignment early and challenge customers constructively when stated goals and actual behaviour diverge.

What You Need to Succeed:[JH8] [CFG9] [KM10]

Comfortable navigating modern CMS/DXP/martech architectures, including headless patterns and API-driven content delivery. You will not write code, but you know what you are looking at in a customer's environment (content models, delivery approaches, integrations, configuration[CFG11] etc).
Business analysis fundamentals: root-cause diagnosis, current-state vs desired-state mapping, converting instance observations into a practical plan (success criteria, sequencing, and ownership).
Working understanding of content strategy and operations: editorial workflows, governance, decision rights, publishing velocity, and operating models
Ability to hold a clear position with senior technical and business stakeholders without retreating into status reporting.
Experience coordinating across multiple delivery workstreams or resources.
Ability to travel, approximately 15% depending on customer. CEs might attend QBRs or workshops onsite.

Additional Skills That Could Set You Apart

Direct experience with Sitecore products (SitecoreAI / XM Cloud, XM/XP, Content Hub, Personalize, Search) or comparable martech.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content workflows and how to position them against real operating-model constraints.
Excellent facilitation and presentation skills across discovery workshops, enablement sessions, and executive reviews.

At Sitecore, we put a lot of care and time into who we hire. We believe that in order to build the best products, we need to build high impact teams. Our recruitment process centers around what we call the Life Story interview, a conversational-style interview where we get to learn more about you.

jobs.description:
Description

Deliver AI Innovation in Compliance at Amazon

Join a team building the future of automated compliance in the product space. Your work will directly impact Amazon's ability to serve customers and partners safely and efficiently across the globe.

We have a unique challenge to overcome: use ML and LLMs at the scale of Amazon. As a software development engineer you will develop scalable LLM infrastructure that can be used to process billions of documents and images each year, in a cost efficient way.

The ideal candidate will be eager to work in a team of innovators and contribute to a suite of tools that power automating and scalable content processing with the end goal of providing Amazon shoppers and sellers with a frictionless and trustworthy shopping and selling experience. You will be working in an Agile mode, collaborating with product management and partner teams to iterate at a fast pace and delight our end users.

Key job responsibilities

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

designing, developing and maintaining distributed systems hosted in AWS;
guiding a team of engineers in writing maintainable code and adhering to operational practices;
defining idiomatic solutions for processing varied types of content with diverse ML solutions and application integrations;
improving performance and operational costs;
researching solutions for technically ambiguous problems.

A day in the life

As senior software engineer’s day typically involves designing or researching technical solutions and alternatives to your team’s most critical and complex features and projects. As a team leader, you will also review your peers’ code and dive deep into their design documents to provide feedback on software architecture, scalability and security. You will code the critical code path in your projects and coordinate with peers on the tasks that you delegated to them. You advise your manager on trade-offs and product future direction.

Compliance Safety Services (CoSS) vision is to provide best-in-class automation of controls for internal compliance and business programs (our primary customers) to lower costs in the Amazon flywheel on behalf of our end customers: buyers and selling partners. Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

API Developer – .NET (Valencia)

At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a healthy baby.

Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services. Based on science and advanced research capabilities, we develop services and products for personalized genetic information and medical device products. We support our customers by improving their clinical practice for the patient's outcome of fertility treatment.

Build Things the Right Way (Together)

We’re seeking a hands-on API Developer to join our API Team in Valencia, Spain, working within the Labs Domain or another internal domain depending on the assignment. Reporting to the Platform Engineering Manager or equivalent, the role follows a hybrid working model aligned with the needs of the team. You’ll turn product goals into robust technical solutions, craft high-quality .NET APIs, champion API-first practices, and collaborate closely with Product Owners, Architects, Security, and Platform teams to deliver reliable, scalable services.

Location:
Parque Tecnológico, Paterna, Valencia, Spain

Your Mission

Your mission will be to develop and take ownership of the API surface supporting the domain’s applications, enabling the team to deliver efficiently, safely, and sustainably. You will balance the need for rapid delivery with the long-term health, scalability, and maintainability of the APIs.

What You’ll Do

Design and evolve the API architecture; define contracts, versioning, security, and observability
Break down features into technical tasks and actionable work
Implement REST and/or gRPC APIs; ensure thorough testing (unit, integration, contract)
Lead or contribute to sprint planning and technical refinement
Maintain DevOps pipelines, CI/CD, monitoring, and operational readiness
Collaborate with Platform, Security, and Enterprise Architecture teams
Mentor peers and raise the technical bar across the team
Identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies, and debt
Support incident resolution and root cause analysis

What You Bring

Strong hands-on experience as a .NET API developer
Proven expertise designing, building, and consuming APIs (REST and/or gRPC)
Deep knowledge of API tooling: OpenAPI/Swagger, contract testing, API gateways, security best practices
Cloud experience with Azure or AWS
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and observability
Strong collaboration and communication skills; able to work with DPO/EA/security teams
Awareness of security, privacy, and audit considerations in API data

Nice to Have

Experience with interoperability standards or cross-domain integrations (non-FHIR)
Regulatory/compliance exposure is a plus but not required
LIMS or enterprise SaaS experience
Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Observability tooling and APM solutions
Spanish would be a plus

Background & Experience

Strong background as a senior engineer or API specialist
Experience delivering API-centric products in agile teams
Proficient with cloud platforms, modern architectures, and DevOps practices
Ability to collaborate with Enterprise Architecture on standards

Why Join Us?

Work on real-world products where technology has a direct impact on the business, laboratory operations, and ultimately patient outcomes.
Join an IT organization that is investing in modern technologies and giving engineering teams a strategic role in the company’s growth.
Have a clear mandate, ownership, and the opportunity to influence technical decisions and ways of working.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Architects, Security, and Platform teams in an international environment.
Be part of a culture that values engineering quality, innovation, collaboration, and sustainable development.
Benefit from a hybrid working model, flexible working hours, and private health insurance.
Please note that the interview process will be conducted in English.

Vitrolife Group is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

We are currently approximately 1 130 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. Vitrolife Group's products and services are available in more than 110 countries through our own presence in 30 countries and a network of distributors. Vitrolife Group is a sustainable market leader and aims to be the preferred partner for IVF-clinics by providing superior products and services with the vision of fulfilling the dream of having a healthy baby. The Vitrolife share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain complex software components that align with business and technical requirements. You will take ownership of feature implementation, troubleshoot technical challenges, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. Your role will involve contributing to technical discussions, refining best practices, and supporting junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing. Your expertise in programming and software engineering will be essential for achieving project goals and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products.

This role is based in Madrid.

What will you be doing?

Contribute to system architecture discussions and develop software components aligned with functional and non-functional requirements.
Creating high-quality, maintainable code in accordance with company best practices and standards.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and optimization to ensure performance, scalability, and reliability.
Develop and maintain cloud-based APIs, microservices, and integrations as part of a collaborative engineering team.
Support junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and sharing technical insights.
Collaborate with the team to refine task prioritization and align work with project goals.
Tackling complex problems requiring deep analysis and evaluation of diverse factors.
Collaborating closely with other teams and departments, such as product teams to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements.
Communicate effectively with team members and external stakeholders to clarify requirements and share progress updates.
Participate in technical discussions, advocate for improvements, and help resolve disagreements constructively.
Providing timely, concise, and actionable feedback to team colleagues.
Share knowledge through documentation, workshops, or informal team sessions.
Assist in technical interviews to evaluate candidates for your team.
Maintaining openness to communication with both local and external partners.
Proactively learn new tools and practices (e.g., DevOps, cloud services) to expand technical expertise.

What are we looking for?

Experience in designing and developing advanced software systems.
Proficiency in object-oriented programming concepts, algorithms, and data structures.
Continuous focus on enhancing skills in software architecture design, and product development.
Strong orientation toward task automation to save time and effort.
Implementation of improvements and optimizations in daily operations.
Planning and managing complex multi-system deployments without impacting client operations.
